author: rdc-rfc1-author-b (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: sw_rst_n_q is a clk_cfg flop that directly drives the asynchronous reset of clk_dma flops, so the DMA reset releases at an arbitrary clk_dma phase.

author_reading.rationale: sw_rst_n_q is generated in the clk_cfg domain and drives the asynchronous reset of clk_dma flops with no synchroniser, so its release is asynchronous to clk_dma.

labels.rationale: sw_rst_n_q is a single clk_cfg flop, and it asynchronously resets beats_q in clk_dma. The release is not synchronised to clk_dma, so the reset is generated in another domain and released unsafely.
Clearing the software request releases DMA reset directly from a configuration-clock flop. Its phase against clk_dma is unrestricted and can violate reset recovery or removal.

settlement.rationale: Final equals A. B agrees on verdict, class and RDC-007/RDC-014, adding incidental RDC-002/RDC-003 and a line 14 site.
